nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the engine interface contracts as Python Protocol classes: LLMEngineProtocol (chat/completion/list_models/health_check), ConfigBuilderProtocol (build/validate/defaults), DeploymentFactoryProtocol (create_deployment), and EngineComponents (data container for registry entries).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python Protocol (structural subtyping) rather than ABC for duck-typing compatibility; EngineComponents is a plain data container holding the three component objects for a registered engine type.

nodes.name: venv_utils.py
nodes.summary: Shared venv utility functions used by all engine deployment factories: validate_venv_name() (regex-based name validation), venv_dir_for() (path resolver), and resolve_venv_path() (looks up venv from engine config, verifies existence, falls back to default).

nodes.name: engine_utils.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI app builder utilities for engine deployments: create_engine_app() (creates a FastAPI app with route-prefix stripping middleware), mount_health() (adds a /health endpoint), and mount_metrics() (mounts a Prometheus ASGI metrics endpoint).

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for the mcps (Model Context Protocol servers) subpackage.

nodes.name: weather_tools.py
nodes.summary: Example FastMCP tool module providing get_alerts() and get_forecast() MCP tools that fetch weather data from the NOAA National Weather Service API, intended as a reference implementation for custom MCP server deployment.

nodes.name: LLMEngineProtocol
nodes.summary: Protocol defining the interface all LLM engine Ray Serve deployments must satisfy: engine_type property, chat_completion, completion, list_models, health_check, and ASGI __call__.

nodes.name: EngineComponents
nodes.summary: Data container holding the three component objects for a registered engine type: an engine class, a config builder, and a deployment factory, stored in the EngineRegistry.

nodes.name: resolve_venv_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the venv directory path from engine config (venv_name key), validates it exists, and falls back to a default name — used by all engine deployment factories before launching the Ray actor.
